includeSystem.description: Include shared read-only system environments under MATOS_SYSTEM_CONDA_ENVS_PATH or /opt/matos-tools/conda/envs.

includeUser.description: Include current-user persistent environments under MATOS_USER_CONDA_ENVS_PATH or /workspace/caches/conda/envs.

probePackages.description: Run each environment's Python to probe selected imports and Torch CUDA metadata. Defaults to false so the catalog returns quickly; enable explicitly for deep preflight.

includeGpu.description: When package probing is enabled, include Torch CUDA availability/device metadata. Set true only when GPU package metadata is needed.

imports.description: Optional import names to probe. Defaults to common scientific and MLIP packages.

limit.description: Maximum number of environments to return.

includeSourceRouting.description: Include the package-source route injected by the MatOS runtime for user environment creation.

format.description: Return a bounded routing summary by default. Use full only for operator diagnostics that need every configured recommendation and runtime hint.
